name: CHAINED FUTURE
detailed_description:
♾️🟦 CHAINED FUTURE

Idle. Dystopian. Meaningful.

The chains have fallen. Control begins.

The year is 2167. The world lies in digital ruins. Central banks turned into hash farms. Nations replaced by protocols. You are a forgotten node — a Node Runner, half human, half interface. You awaken in an isolated mining zone, guided by a voice in your head:
"Reconstruct the truth. Rebuild the chain. Take control of the network."

🧬 FEATURES:

🔸 Not your typical clicker:
Chained Future isn't about mindless clicking. Your gear, drops, tree layers, and forks all shape long-term progression.

🔸 Deep idle & prestige systems:
Even while offline, your rig generates resources — but only if you’ve managed energy and storage wisely. Optimize your mining and economy through decisions that matter.

🔸 Gear that matters:
24 gear slots, set bonuses, rarity from Common to Relic, with every item affecting your character — nothing collects dust.

🔸 Steam Marketplace integration:
All items from Epic rarity onward are tradeable, each with a unique ID, drop number, and visible ownership history. Designed for collectors and traders alike.

🔸 Dystopian sci-fi lore & factions:
Uncover the story of the “Great Disconnect”. Align with or oppose:

  • 🧠 Consensus Protocol (religious mining AI cult)

  • 🐍 Forkborn (data mutations)

  • 💼 SyndiKey (token mafias)

  • 🛰️ Relic Hunters (neutral, greedy, unpredictable)

🔸 Fork & Layer Systems:
Grow stronger through Layer nodes and traits and Fork System to gain permanent bonuses and alternate routes. Strategic decisions matter.

Coming 2025 – The Chain awaits.

Who controls it, controls the flow of reality.
Will you rebuild it — or be rewritten?
